propositions: Copilot, Codex, and Claude clients must be wired to connect to the rebar MCP server over remote HTTPS using static bearer token authentication from environment variables
Client config examples must be provided for each of the three clients (copilot/mcp-config.json, codex/config.toml, claude/.mcp.json) with environment variable references but no committed PAT secrets
A hermetic test suite must validate real client config loads, resolve bearer tokens via documented substitution, and confirm successful read-tool calls over a loopback rebar-mcp HTTP instance
The test suite must verify that invalid or absent bearer tokens result in 401 responses, confirming the Authorization header is on the request path
Client-specific acceptance checks must load and parse the committed example configs using the real client binaries where installed, with skip-with-reason behavior when binaries are absent
